solver_notes: Real Linux kernel regression on aarch64 using four epoll instances sharing one nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT loopback listener. Legacy registration omits EPOLLEXCLUSIVE and produces measurable thundering-herd wakeups and spurious EWOULDBLOCK. Fixed registration requires EPOLLEXCLUSIVE in epoll_ctl (failure is fatal) and assigns each accepted descriptor with an atomic lock-free ticket. Three native comparison runs each accepted exactly 128 connections in both lanes and distributed them 32/32/32/32. Legacy wakeups were 341/352/351 with 213/224/223 spurious EWOULDBLOCK; fixed wakeups were exactly 128 with zero spurious EWOULDBLOCK in every run. Scope: standalone real-kernel reproduction/fix for the stated net/socket/epoll_server.c invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream Crossbeam.
